title: Big Paper Murals
description: Paint one musical papercraft mural with two fingers at once, wake playful collage stamps, replay every color, and save a local keepsake.
learningGoals: Explore color, line, shape, rhythm, and spatial composition
Build creative confidence through open-ended expression
Notice how visual choices can become musical patterns
interactionModel: choose a starter paper; paint or roll with multiple fingers; tap to place living stamps; replay the mural as overlapping color tracks; save locally
feedbackModel: every stroke makes gentle pitched music, stamps bounce and sound, and the finished mural becomes a playful instrument with no score or wrong answer
credits: QLOBE Kids contributors; production papercraft assets generated with GPT Image 2 and extracted with the local Qwen Image Layered workflow (see ASSETS.md).
